description: HACK THE CIRCLE | Build. Ship. Surprise. Got an idea worth building? A problem worth solving? A project that deserves its moment? Hack the Circle , presented by Open Circle, MAIT , is an open-source-focused hackathon where ideas turn into working solutions, code meets creativity, and builders get their chance to shine. And the rewards? Let's just say the story doesn't end with the code. Choose Your Track Pick one track that best fits your project: AI/ML: Intelligent systems, automation, and data-driven solutions. Blockchain: Web3, smart contracts, and decentralised applications. Cybersecurity: Security tools, privacy, and threat detection. Open Innovation: Creative tech solutions to real-world problems. Two Rounds. One Circle. Round 1: Idea Drop | Online Screening Submit your project presentation in PDF format only , along with your public GitHub repository link . Your PDF must cover the problem, solution, key features, tech stack, feasibility, selected track, and existing project progress, if applicable. Existing projects are allowed. Be transparent about work already completed. Round 2: Build, Ship, Pitch | Offline Finale at MAIT Shortlisted teams will develop or improve their projects, demonstrate their solutions, and pitch to the judges. The entire finale, including development, submissions, demos, judging, and awards, takes place within 6 hours . Team Rules Team size: 1–4 members . Inter-college and inter-specialisation teams are welcome. Each participant can register with only one team. Only shortlisted teams qualify for the offline finale. Before You Submit Select one primary track during Round 1 registration and mention it in your PDF. Ensure your GitHub repository is public and accessible. Submit all required materials before the announced deadline. Give credit for existing work and third-party resources. Plagiarism, misrepresentation, and unauthorised security testing are prohibited. Participants must follow the official guidelines and organisers' instruct

raw.details:
HACK THE CIRCLE | Build. Ship. Surprise.

Got an idea worth building? A problem worth solving? A project that deserves its moment?

Hack the Circle, presented by Open Circle, MAIT, is an open-source-focused hackathon where ideas turn into working solutions, code meets creativity, and builders get their chance to shine.

And the rewards? Let's just say the story doesn't end with the code.

Choose Your Track

Pick one track that best fits your project:

  • AI/ML: Intelligent systems, automation, and data-driven solutions.

  • Blockchain: Web3, smart contracts, and decentralised applications.

  • Cybersecurity: Security tools, privacy, and threat detection.

  • Open Innovation: Creative tech solutions to real-world problems.

Two Rounds. One Circle.

Round 1: Idea Drop | Online Screening

Submit your project presentation in PDF format only, along with your public GitHub repository link. Your PDF must cover the problem, solution, key features, tech stack, feasibility, selected track, and existing project progress, if applicable.

Existing projects are allowed. Be transparent about work already completed.

Round 2: Build, Ship, Pitch | Offline Finale at MAIT

Shortlisted teams will develop or improve their projects, demonstrate their solutions, and pitch to the judges.

The entire finale, including development, submissions, demos, judging, and awards, takes place within 6 hours.

Team Rules

  • Team size: 1–4 members.

  • Inter-college and inter-specialisation teams are welcome.

  • Each participant can register with only one team.

  • Only shortlisted teams qualify for the offline finale.

Before You Submit

  • Select one primary track during Round 1 registration and mention it in your PDF.

  • Ensure your GitHub repository is public and accessible.

  • Submit all required materials before the announced deadline.

  • Give credit for existing work and third-party resources.

  • Plagiarism, misrepresentation, and unauthorised security testing are prohibited.

  • Participants must follow the official guidelines and organisers' instructions.

Read the complete hackathon guidelines carefully before registering.

Join the Circle

Join the official WhatsApp group for important announcements, instructions, and event updates:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/LcypwEaWyhw4X6gEzXKAY4

And About Those Rewards...

Bring your ideas. Bring your best code. Bring something worth remembering.

The challenge is real. The competition is on. And there's more waiting at the finish line than you might expect.

Think you've got what it takes? Enter the Circle. Hack the Circle.
